description: Fixed visual audit for first-room production lantern emissive Frames.
occlusion_rule: Metal housing and hanging hardware may change only when the pose or loop clearly occludes them; do not add glow, flame, or housing detail through unrelated surfaces.

fixed_questions.question: Do the metal housing and hanging point remain stable identity anchors across the loop?
Do amber core changes read as intentional flicker rather than accidental one-Frame noise?
At native scale, are flame, core, and housing separated rather than accidentally melding at same-value contacts?
Do upper-left metal highlights stay consistent with first-room local lighting?
Does the four-Frame sequence close as a readable loop without a visible seam break?

emissive.question: Do emission and glow changes stay inside the lamp housing without spilling onto unrelated Cells?
Is there no baked terrain-scale halo outside the lamp silhouette?

editing_rules: Use the fewest changed Cells that resolves the observed defect.
Use only colors already allowed by the combined Draft palette.
Never change alpha, baseline, dimensions, Frame order, or silhouette.
Prefer restoring housing separation or intentional flicker over adding decorative detail.
Return UNCERTAIN instead of inventing intent when the profile and pose do not settle the edit.
audit_workflow: Read the machine-readable check report before opening art.
Inspect one composite or animation preview at native scale and enlarged with nearest-neighbor scaling.
Answer every fixed question and every applicable Motion-class override.
Apply the fewest permitted Cell edits for EDIT verdicts.
Re-render the preview and run strip:polish check.
Report every UNCERTAIN verdict and do not finalize until it is resolved.
